title: Compute the residue degree of a polynomial-local place
statement: Let K and F be fields with a K-algebra structure on F, let x ∈ F be transcendental over K, and let q ∈ K[T] be monic and irreducible. Let v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F satisfy: for every f ∈ F, f belongs to v.toValuationSubring exactly when f = a(x)/b(x) for polynomials a,b with q not dividing b. Then v.deg = q.natDegree. No assumption that all elements of F are rational expressions in x is required.
lean_statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → ∀ q : Polynomial K, q.Monic → Irreducible q → ∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, (∀ f : F, f ∈ v.toValuationSubring ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) → v.deg = q.natDegree
